g.text: Region: canadacentral · One experimental variable: the RAI egress policy mode
Exactly two tools, both always registered. Identical image digest in both runs.
default Deny + one Fqdn Allow rule (no port or IP matching)
RAI policies — the only thing that differs between runs
Inbound topology only. This is not where egress is controlled.
Agentic harness — stands in for the on-premises caller.
Calls the agent over A2A (JSONRPC 1.0), authenticated with Entra ID.
Its ingress is the ONLY public surface in this environment.
Phase 8+: Dapr Workflow app runs here too.
Foundry PE → 3 DNS zones: cognitiveservices · openai · services.ai
Governs INBOUND only. It does not contain agent egress.
PostgreSQL Flexible Server — Phase 8, enable_state_store = false (not created)
Identical from the application's point of view. No code knows which is which.
Named by the egress policy's single Allow rule.
Deliberately absent from the allowlist. No receipt must appear.
Evidence — three independent layers, correlated by demo_run_id + trace ID
Two out of three is INCONCLUSIVE, never a pass. A bare HTTP 403 proves nothing — the egress proxy and an ordinary rejection look identical.
